note: This file is a MMDetection configuration file containing only variable assignments and dictionary literals. It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It extends mask-rcnn_r101_fpn_gn-all_2x_coco.py and overrides training epochs to 36 with a LinearLR warmup and MultiStepLR scheduler.
config_max_epochs: configure the training to run for 36 epochs with a LinearLR warmup and MultiStepLR scheduler
config_train_cfg: set the training configuration max_epochs to 36 for the Mask R-CNN ResNet101 FPN model
config_param_scheduler: configure a LinearLR warmup followed by MultiStepLR with milestones at epoch 28 and 34
config_base_inheritance: extend the mask-rcnn_r101_fpn_gn-all_2x_coco base configuration with 3x training schedule
config_gn_all: configure Group Normalization all-variant Mask R-CNN with ResNet101 backbone and FPN for 36 epoch training
